statement: Complete and dogfood DevRelay's deterministic V1 lifecycle end to end, expose a human-readable evidence-backed run report, and optimize only after a measured complete run exists.
objectives: Freeze the exact V1 lifecycle, conditional routes, Gates, and repeating dependency-ready execution frontier.
Build each remaining module through the currently approved DevRelay modules and add it to the active circuit only after its Gate passes.
Keep SpecialistAssignment provider-neutral and separate readiness, scheduling, execution, verification, and integration authority.
Generate a dynamic human-readable LifecycleRunReport.md backed by standardized run records and TraceabilityGraph.
Complete one accepted end-to-end dogfood run before using measured evidence to optimize the framework.
constraints: Core owns deterministic routing, adapter resolution, artifact validation, checkpointing, Gate progression, and ready-frontier derivation.
Modules own bounded transformations and adapters remain replaceable, versioned, and untrusted.
TraceabilityGraph and lifecycle reporting are cross-cutting infrastructure rather than workflow stages.
Only sourced performance values or explicit absence dispositions may appear in the run report.
No candidate becomes authoritative without its exact digest-bound Gate approval.
Deployment and production operations remain outside the V1 construction and business-acceptance boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: The approved ProjectOverview contains the exact eighteen-component V1 sequence and repeating frontier loop.
Every remaining lifecycle component has a versioned contract, deterministic routing, Gate or outcome semantics, verification evidence, and traceability behavior.
One complete run progresses from approved requirements through BusinessAcceptanceGate with no implicit bypass.
The generated LifecycleRunReport.md dynamically covers all attempted stages, Gates, artifacts, adapter maturity, rework, performance observations, and next actions.
The report remains non-authoritative and cannot change lifecycle state, evidence, routing, or approval.
Optimization recommendations cite measured end-to-end run evidence.
assumptions: The owner-approved sequence and boundaries recorded in owner-decisions.md are final for the V1 construction run.
The bounded OpenSpec conversation-contract adapter records this RequirementsGathering run without claiming upstream OpenSpec CLI execution.
Unavailable host timing, token, and cost data will be explicitly marked not-reported rather than inferred.
